learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge and skills in human resources management.
Recognize and analyze the concept of Human Resources in detail.
Know the processes related to Human Resource Development.
Analyze examples of human resources management from different countries.
Propose original models based on different human resources practices.

syllabus_topics: Separation, Discipline, Employee/Employer Relations (Contracts, Rights, Unionization)
Problems of Human Resources Management in Turkey
Difference between HRM and Personnel Management
bibliography: Lloyd L. Byars & Leslie W. Rue. Human Resource Management.
Kaynak, T. (2000). İnsan Kaynakları Yönetimi. İ.Ü. İşletme Fakültesi İşletme İktisadı Enstitüsü Araştırma ve Yardım Vakfı Yayın No.7
Uyargil, C. (2010). İnsan Kaynakları Yönetimi. İstanbul: Beta yayıncılık
Richard, S. (2013). Human Resources Administration: A school based perspective. Routledge.
